searchText: <@!636680106630316033>, good point, there may be code deduplication opportunities, even for code chunks. Feel free to modify the current witness spec, maybe by overhauling the contract account field `<Bytecode>` or by adding a new top-level section for code deduplication. Some concerns. Code deduplication - complicates canonicalness checks (what is canonical code deduplication?), - increases witness building cost, which grows as you have more code to check for deduplication, - is not free (there is overhead to encode that there is duplication), - may not have significant savings, especially if there is regenesis.
